note: A gate is a step in the funnel that an account can sit at without moving. `from` is the rung it has reached, `to` is what it has not done, `days` is how long it may sit there before somebody owes an explanation. `code` is stored in Airtable and never shown; `label` is what the associate picks. Changing a label is free. Changing a CODE orphans every answer already recorded under the old one, so add a new code instead and retire the old. doneNoSql added 2026-09-19 for the prototype's second RCA chart, "After the SQL meeting". 14 days is a starting number, not a measured one — it is shorter than the two gates before it because the funnel narrows: an account that has had the meeting is the one worth chasing soonest. discoveryNoBooking's reasons replaced 2026-10-12 with Ayush's list ("Reasons for Not Booking an SQL Meeting after Successful Discovery Call") — the five labels only, no descriptions yet, and no 'Something else' because his list has none. The RCA table held no answers then, so no old code was orphaned.
